title: Nixon–Ford era decision to privatize the legacy program

tellings.quote: legacy program lore, which has since filtered out, um, is that there was a decision made in the Nixon administration into the Ford administration to essentially privatize this

plain: Under Presidents Nixon and Ford, between 1969 and 1977, a decision is said to have been made to hand the government's long-running secret UFO effort, which insiders call the legacy program, over to private companies. A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown passes this on as "legacy program lore" that has since leaked out from people he has heard from. If true, it would explain why the material sits outside normal government oversight.
